branch out into new markets: After years of selling only in Taiwan, the tea company decided to branch out into new markets in Japan and Korea.
在台灣只銷售多年後，這家茶葉公司決定拓展新市場，進軍日本和韓國。
the road branches off: About two kilometers past the village, the road branches off, and you should turn left toward the lake.
過了村莊大約兩公里，道路分岔，你應該左轉往湖邊走。
branch into retail: The farm used to sell its fruit only to supermarkets, but last year it began to branch into retail with its own shop.
這座農場過去只把水果賣給超市，但去年開始跨足零售，開了自己的店。
breathe new life into: The young chef hopes to breathe new life into the old restaurant by adding modern dishes to the menu.
這位年輕主廚希望在菜單上加入新式料理，為這家老餐廳注入新活力。
breathe a sigh of relief: When the doctor said the test results were normal, my mother finally breathed a sigh of relief.
當醫生說檢查結果正常時，我媽媽終於鬆了一口氣。
breathe easy: Now that the final exam is over and the scores are out, the students can finally breathe easy.
既然期末考結束、成績也公布了，學生們終於可以放心了。
breathe down one's neck: It is hard to concentrate on my work when my boss keeps breathing down my neck all day.
老闆整天緊盯著我，讓我很難專心工作。
breed resentment: Treating some workers better than others will only breed resentment among the rest of the team.
對某些員工比其他人好，只會在團隊其他成員之間滋生不滿。
breed violence: Many experts believe that poverty and a lack of education can breed violence in a community.
許多專家認為，貧窮和缺乏教育會在社區中滋生暴力。
familiarity breeds contempt: They were best friends before becoming roommates, but familiarity breeds contempt, and now they argue every day.
他們成為室友前是最好的朋友，但親暱生侮慢，現在他們每天吵架。
breed dogs: My uncle has a large farm in the countryside where he breeds dogs and sells the puppies to families.
我叔叔在鄉下有一座大農場，他在那裡繁殖狗，並把小狗賣給家庭。
bridge the gap: The program offers free tutoring to bridge the gap between students from rich and poor families.
這個計畫提供免費家教，以彌合富裕和貧困家庭學生之間的差距。
bridge the generation divide: Teaching grandparents to use smartphones is one simple way to bridge the generation divide in a family.
教祖父母使用智慧型手機，是家庭中跨越世代鴻溝的一個簡單方法。
bridge differences: The two leaders met for three days, hoping to bridge differences over trade and reach an agreement.
兩位領袖會面三天，希望化解在貿易上的分歧並達成協議。
broadcast live: The opening ceremony of the Olympic Games will be broadcast live on TV and on the Internet tonight.
奧運開幕典禮今晚將在電視和網路上現場直播。
broadcast one's views: He likes to broadcast his views on politics to everyone at dinner, even when nobody asks him.
他喜歡在晚餐時向每個人到處宣揚他的政治看法，即使沒人問他。
broadcast the news: The TV station interrupted its regular show to broadcast the news about the strong earthquake.
電視台中斷了一般節目，播報關於強烈地震的新聞。
browse the Internet: I usually browse the Internet for an hour before bed, reading articles and watching short videos.
我睡前通常會瀏覽網路一小時，看文章和短影片。
browse through a magazine: While waiting at the dentist's office, I browsed through a magazine about travel in Europe.
在牙醫診所等候時，我翻閱了一本關於歐洲旅遊的雜誌。
browse the shelves: I love spending Saturday afternoons in the bookstore, slowly browsing the shelves for something new to read.
我喜歡週六下午待在書店，慢慢隨意看架上的書，找些新東西來讀。
bubble with excitement: On the morning of the school trip, the children were bubbling with excitement and could not sit still.
校外教學那天早上，孩子們興奮不已，坐都坐不住。
the housing bubble burst: When the housing bubble burst, many families found their homes were worth much less than they had paid.
房市泡沫破滅時，許多家庭發現他們的房子價值遠低於當初的購買價。
bubble up to the surface: Old problems between the two brothers began to bubble up to the surface during their father's illness.
在父親生病期間，兩兄弟之間的舊問題開始浮上檯面。
budget for the trip: We need to budget for the trip carefully, because hotels in Tokyo are expensive during the holidays.
我們需要仔細為這趟旅行編預算，因為東京的飯店在假期期間很貴。
budget ten minutes: When you take the writing test, budget ten minutes at the end to check your spelling and grammar.
考寫作測驗時，最後要預留十分鐘檢查拼字和文法。
budget carefully: Since moving out on my own, I have learned to budget carefully so I don't run out of money.
自從搬出去自己住，我學會了精打細算，才不會把錢花光。
a tight budget: We are on a tight budget this month, so we will cook at home instead of eating out.
我們這個月預算吃緊，所以會在家煮飯，而不是外食。
bully classmates: Students who bully classmates online can be punished by the school, just like those who do it in person.
在網路上霸凌同學的學生會受到學校處罰，就像當面霸凌的人一樣。
bully someone into doing: The older boys tried to bully him into doing their homework, but he told the teacher instead.
那些大男孩試圖脅迫他幫他們寫作業，但他反而告訴了老師。
